articles.titleCn: 在希腊出版社环境下的嵌入与大型语言模型比较评估——CUP数据集
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了CUP，一个由868条目录记录和104条专家标注的具有分级相关性判断的查询组成的希腊书籍检索基准。我们在书籍搜索场景中评估了稀疏（BM25）、密集（sentence-transformers）、混合和LLM辅助的检索方法。多语言嵌入优于特定希腊语的模型，而混合检索总体表现最佳。查询级别的分析表明，BM25在命名实体查询方面表现出色，而密集和混合方法则提升了自然语言、含噪声、跨语言和概念查询的性能。领域感知提示具有模型特定的效果，而LLM目录摘要改进了仅目录检索，LLM后过滤则在高成本下提升了早期阶段的检索。总体而言，CUP能够对希腊语检索在词汇、语义、含噪声和跨语言查询方面进行现实世界的评估。

articles.title: slang.gr as a Large-Scale Crowdsourced Resource for Non-Standard Greek
articles.abstract: Slang is a central component of everyday language, reflecting linguistic creativity, social identity, and cultural change, yet its dy- namic and non-standard nature makes it difficult to model computationally. We present the first large-scale computational study of slang.gr, a crowdsourced lexicon of Greek non-standard language, combining lexical content, user-generated tags, and interaction data. To enable the systematic analysis, we map noisy folksonomic tags to a structured multi-layer taxonomy capturing both semantic categories and sociolinguistic metadata. Using this representation, we analyze the linguistic structure of Greek slang and the behavior of its contributor community. We find that slang is strongly centered on person-related and evaluative language, exhibits high morphological creativity, and is shaped by highly skewed participation with short user lifespans and overlapping communities. Building on these signals, we introduce a community-based confidence score for definitions that integrates user roles, interaction patterns, and moderation signals. Our results show that taxonomy-based representations improve interpretability while retaining meaningful aspects of behavioral structure, enabling a more structured and interpretable analysis of confidence signals. Overall, this work establishes slang.gr as a computational resource for non-standard Greek and provides a foundation for sociolinguistic NLP, bias analysis, and the study of informal language in LLMs.

articles.titleCn: slang.gr作为一个大规模非标准希腊语众包资源
articles.abstractCn: 俚语是日常语言的核心组成部分，反映了语言的创造性、社会身份和文化变迁，但其动态性和非规范性使其难以进行计算建模。我们首次对slang.gr——一个希腊非标准语言众包词汇库——进行了大规模计算研究，结合词汇内容、用户生成标签和交互数据。为支持系统性分析，我们将嘈杂的民科分类标签映射到一个结构化的多层分类体系，该体系既包含语义类别，也涵盖社会语言学元数据。基于这一表示形式，我们分析了希腊俚语的语言结构及其贡献者社区的行为模式。我们发现，俚语高度集中于与人物相关的评价性语言，表现出极高的形态创造性，并受到参与度高度倾斜、用户生命周期短和社区重叠的影响。基于这些信号，我们引入了一种基于社区的置信度评分机制，该机制整合了用户角色、交互模式和审核信号。我们的结果表明，基于分类体系的表示形式提升了可解释性，同时保留了行为结构的有意义方面，从而实现了对置信度信号更结构化和可解释的分析。总体而言，这项工作将slang.gr确立为非标准希腊语的计算资源，并为社会语言学NLP、偏见分析和LLMs中非正式语言的研究奠定了基础。

articles.title: Progressive Cramming: Reliable Token Compression and What It Reveals
articles.abstract: Token cramming compresses sequences into learned embeddings with near-perfect reconstruction, but fixed token budgets and 99\% accuracy thresholds leave it unclear whether residual errors reflect optimization failures or fundamental limits. We introduce progressive cramming, which grows the target prefix token-by-token, stopping only when reconstruction is no longer achievable within a fixed optimization budget. Progressive trajectories occupy low-dimensional structure in embedding space. Prepending a crammed embedding causes a moderate but consistent accuracy drop on multiple-choice benchmarks even with the original prefix in context, and collapses capability almost entirely under generative evaluation. Causal attention-knockout interventions trace this degradation to the embedding's interactions in the model's early layers. These results position progressive cramming as a tool for studying compression limits and show that perfect reconstruction - achievable through brittle steering rather than transferable semantics - is insufficient for meaningful compression.
articles.titleCn: 渐进式强行压缩：可靠的令牌压缩及其揭示的内容
articles.abstractCn: Token cramming 将序列压缩成具有近乎完美重建效果的学习嵌入，但固定的 token 预算和 99% 的准确率阈值使得残余误差难以判断是优化失败还是根本限制。我们引入渐进式 cramming，该技术逐个 token 增长目标前缀，仅在无法在固定优化预算内实现重建时停止。渐进式轨迹在嵌入空间中占据低维结构。即使原始前缀在上下文中，追加压缩嵌入仍会导致多项选择基准测试中中等程度但一致的准确率下降，并在生成式评估下几乎完全丧失能力。因果注意力阻断干预将这种退化归因于嵌入在模型早期层中的交互作用。这些结果将渐进式 cramming 定位为研究压缩极限的工具，并表明完美重建——通过脆弱的引导而非可迁移的语义实现——不足以实现有意义的压缩。

articles.title: One More Turn, Less Regret: A Regret-Based Multi-Turn Benchmark for LLMs' Clarification Policies
articles.abstract: Ambiguous user requests make clarification a sequential decision problem for conversational LLM assistants: they must decide whether to ask, what to ask, when to stop, and when to answer. We introduce RegretBench, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates clarification as policy behavior rather than isolated question quality. RegretBench provides a hidden-intent formulation of ambiguity, supports free-form interaction grounded in semantic-state tracking, and introduces a regret-based objective that measures how much value a model loses relative to a reference clarification policy. Experiments on open-domain QA and product recommendation scenarios show that final success alone is insufficient, as models with similar accuracy can differ substantially in efficiency, robustness to user behaviors, and stopping decisions. By jointly measuring intent resolution, interaction cost, ineffective clarification, and regret, RegretBench reveals whether models clarify usefully and efficiently. Our results show that effective clarification requires more than plausible questions: models must ask the right question at the right time and stop once the user's intended meaning is clear.
articles.titleCn: 再试一次，少些遗憾：一个基于遗憾的多轮基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型的澄清策略
articles.abstractCn: 模糊的用户请求使得澄清成为对话式大语言模型助手的一个序列决策问题：它们必须决定是否提问、提什么问题、何时停止以及何时回答。我们介绍了RegretBench，这是一个多轮基准，它将澄清视为策略行为而非孤立的问题质量进行评估。RegretBench提供了一种隐藏意图的模糊性表述，支持基于语义状态追踪的自由形式交互，并引入了一个基于后悔值的客观指标，用于衡量模型相对于参考澄清策略所损失的价值。在开放域问答和产品推荐场景中的实验表明，仅凭最终成功是不够的，因为准确度相似的模型在效率、对用户行为的鲁棒性以及停止决策方面可能存在巨大差异。通过联合衡量意图解析、交互成本、无效澄清和后悔值，RegretBench揭示了模型是否进行了有用且高效的澄清。我们的结果表明，有效的澄清不仅仅需要合理的提问：模型必须在正确的时间提出正确的问题，并在用户的意图明确后停止。

articles.title: Training Large Language Models for Self-Explanation Faithfulness
articles.abstract: We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) method to directly optimize the faithfulness of self-explanations - the extent to which a model's generated reasoning accurately reflects its internal decision-making process. While existing work focuses on evaluating faithfulness or using inference-time prompting frameworks to improve an LLM's self-explanation's tractability, these approaches do not provide a mechanism to directly optimize a model's parameters to generate faithful self-explanations. We bridge this gap by modifying existing faithfulness metrics into an RL training objective. We investigate (1) if models can be trained to accurately detect factors that affect their decisions, and (2) whether RL can directly optimize for the disclosure of these factors thereby improving LLM self-explanations' faithfulness. We experiment with two intervention types: random-word insertions and user-bias insertions, using a per-sample reward derived from the Phi-CCT correlation metric. RL fine-tuned Llama3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B show substantial improvements on the Phi-CCT faithfulness metric, with in-distribution scores rising from near-zero to as high as 0.664, and out-of-distribution scores reaching up to 0.691 on held-out tasks such as StrategyQA. Cross-intervention generalization is weaker but more interesting: a priori we would not expect a model trained only on random word insertions to generalize to user-bias phrases, yet Llama3.1-8B shows non-zero transfer in this direction. The reverse direction and Qwen3-8B do not replicate this, indicating model-dependent and setup-dependent effects we cannot yet explain. Lastly we analyze model behavior to rule out reward gaming behaviors that often plague RL training. Ultimately, we show that models can be trained to implicitly identify influential factors and disclose them, offering a scalable path toward reducing unfaithful reasoning in LLMs.

articles.titleCn: 用于自解释忠实性的大型语言模型训练
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种强化学习（RL）方法，用于直接优化自我解释的忠实度——即模型生成的推理与其内部决策过程相一致的程度。现有工作主要集中于评估忠实度或使用推理时提示框架来提高大型语言模型（LLM）自我解释的可操作性，但这些方法并未提供直接优化模型参数以生成忠实自我解释的机制。我们通过将现有忠实度指标修改为RL训练目标来填补这一空白。我们研究了（1）模型是否能够被训练以准确检测影响其决策的因素，以及（2）RL是否能够直接优化这些因素的披露，从而提高LLM自我解释的忠实度。我们实验了两种干预类型：随机词插入和用户偏见插入，并使用Phi-CCT相关性指标推导出每样本奖励。经过RL微调的Llama3.1-8B和Qwen3-8B在Phi-CCT忠实度指标上表现出显著提升，分布内得分从接近零提升至高达0.664，分布外得分在StrategyQA等保留任务上达到0.691。跨干预泛化较弱但更具启发性：我们原本不会预期仅经过随机词插入训练的模型能够泛化到用户偏见短语，但Llama3.1-8B在该方向上显示出非零迁移。反向方向和Qwen3-8B未能复制这一现象，表明存在模型依赖和设置依赖效应，目前尚无法解释。最后，我们分析模型行为以排除奖励博弈行为，这些行为常困扰RL训练。最终，我们证明模型可以被训练以隐式识别关键因素并披露它们，为减少LLM中的不忠实推理提供了一种可扩展的路径。

articles.title: VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet Technical Report
articles.abstract: We present VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet, a compressed variant of VibeVoice-ASR optimized for real-time inference on edge CPUs. We apply heterogeneous quantization tailored to the computational characteristics of each stage: the VAE acoustic tokenizer uses full-pipeline INT8 quantization (I8_S) with kernel fusion and SIMD optimization, while the autoregressive language model adopts BitNet-style ternary weights (I2_S). To preserve accuracy under aggressive compression, we employ a progressive quantization-aware training strategy. For inference, we implement custom SIMD kernels and fused operators within the ggml framework targeting both ARM and x86 platforms, achieving real-time recognition (RTF < 1) on low-thread-count CPUs. VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet is 1.6--2.3x faster than Whisper.cpp at comparable model sizes (~1.6 GB), with only modest accuracy degradation compared to the FP16 baseline.

articles.titleCn: VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet，这是VibeVoice-ASR的一种压缩变体，专为边缘CPU上的实时推理进行了优化。我们应用了针对每个阶段计算特性的异构量化：VAE声学标记器采用全流程INT8量化（I8_S），并结合了内核融合和SIMD优化，而自回归语言模型则采用了BitNet风格的二值权重（I2_S）。为了在激进压缩下保持准确性，我们采用了渐进式量化感知训练策略。在推理方面，我们在ggml框架中实现了定制的SIMD内核和融合算子，支持ARM和x86平台，在低线程数CPU上实现了实时识别（RTF < 1）。VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet在同等模型大小（~1.6 GB）下，比Whisper.cpp快1.6--2.3倍，与FP16基线相比，准确率仅有轻微下降。

articles.title: PrefReward: Learning User Preference Matrix for Personalized Text Generation
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable ability in generating personalized content by leveraging user histories and contextual cues. However, most existing personalization approaches rely on implicit representations within model parameters, making it difficult to interpret user-specific preferences or effectively handle long-context dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose PrefReward, a novel preference-aware generative framework that explicitly models user styles through a structured preference matrix and integrates it into the decoding process as a reward signal. PrefReward consists of two stages: (1) extracting a user-specific preference matrix that summarizes individual stylistic tendencies, and (2) using the matrix to guide generation via a KL-divergence-based reward function. Experiments on the LongLaMP dataset show that PrefReward outperforms non-personalized and retrieval-based baselines in both generation quality and personalization interpretability.
articles.titleCn: 偏好奖励：用于个性化文本生成的用户偏好矩阵学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过利用用户历史记录和上下文线索，在生成个性化内容方面展现出卓越的能力。然而，大多数现有的个性化方法依赖于模型参数中的隐式表示，这使得难以解释用户特定的偏好或有效处理长上下文依赖关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了PrefReward，这是一种新颖的偏好感知生成框架，它通过结构化的偏好矩阵显式地建模用户风格，并将其作为奖励信号整合到解码过程中。PrefReward包含两个阶段：（1）提取一个总结个体风格倾向的用户特定偏好矩阵；（2）使用该矩阵通过基于KL散度的奖励函数来指导生成。在LongLaMP数据集上的实验表明，PrefReward在生成质量和个性化可解释性方面均优于非个性化及基于检索的基线模型。

articles.title: QuantiBias: Benchmarking Quantization-Induced Bias in LLMs
articles.abstract: Almost every large language model that reaches a broad audience is quantized: trained in full precision, then compressed for efficiency. This step is assumed harmless and its safety is rarely re-checked. We find its principal side effect is increased bias that standard safety evaluation misses. Holding the model, its training, and the prompts fixed, a quantized model still refuses harmful requests, still avoids over-refusing benign prompts, and still selects the unbiased multiple-choice answer. Yet asked an open-ended question, the same model volunteers stereotypes in all eight languages we probe, in roughly one in four open-ended answers under an independent judge (~24% to ~27% across the compression ladder): it passes every standard check and still reaches users measurably more biased. The selective gap is a robust finding; whether open-ended bias further increases with compression is less certain, sensitive to the judge that scores it. We address both with \textbf{QuantiBias}, a benchmark that pairs a generative, multilingual stereotype probe with the refusal and multiple-choice controls that isolate open-ended generation, contrasts each build with and without reasoning, and rates the content severity of what it generates. Across two backbone models (Qwen and Gemma), a five-family screen, and eight benchmarks, quantizers allocate their extra precision by capability data that carries no bias-prevention signal, and reasoning before answering roughly halves the effect on some families while doing nothing on others. A quantized build must be re-evaluated for open-ended bias, not only on the short-form safeguards it already passes.

articles.titleCn: QuantiBias：基准测试LLM中的量化诱导偏差
articles.abstractCn: 几乎所有面向广大用户的语言模型都经过了量化处理：先用全精度进行训练，然后为了提高效率而压缩。这一步骤被认为是无害的，其安全性也很少重新检验。我们发现其主要副作用是增加了标准安全评估会忽略的偏见。在固定模型、训练过程和提示的情况下，量化后的模型仍然拒绝有害请求，仍然避免过度满足良性提示，仍然选择无偏见的单选题答案。然而，当被问及开放式问题时，同一模型在八种我们测试的语言中都主动提供了刻板印象，在独立评委评估下（约24%至27%的压缩等级中），大约每四分之一（约25%）的开放式回答中如此：它通过了所有标准检查，但用户感受到的偏见程度更高。这种选择性差距是一个稳健的发现；开放式偏见是否会随着压缩进一步增加尚不明确，且取决于评分该偏见的评委。我们通过 \textbf{QuantiBias} 来解决这两个问题，这是一个基准测试，它将生成式、多语言刻板印象探测与拒绝和单选题控制相结合，以隔离开放式生成，对比每个模型的推理前与推理后版本，并评估其生成内容的严重性。在两个主干模型（Qwen和Gemma）、五个家族筛选和八个基准测试中，量化器通过不携带偏见预防信号的能力数据分配其额外的精度，而回答前的推理大致使某些家族的效果减半，而对另一些家族则毫无影响。量化后的模型必须重新评估其开放式偏见，而不仅仅是检查它已经通过的短式安全措施。

articles.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
articles.abstract: Real-world agent learning is often constrained by costly environment interactions, such as running time-consuming experiments or obtaining human feedback. In-context learning offers a highly sample-efficient way for agents to learn from their own interaction histories, but its gains disappear once that experience is removed from the context. Separately, context distillation provides a mechanism for internalizing contextual information into model weights. However, applying it to agents' interaction histories without sacrificing environment sample efficiency remains underexplored. We term this problem Experience Distillation and develop an implementation that requires no further environment interaction beyond the collected experience. Experiments on 749 curated software-engineering tasks and six text-adventure games show that it retains at least 64.8\% of the gains from in-context learning across both domains, whereas direct supervised fine-tuning on the collected experience recovers only 3.8\%. Compared with classical reinforcement-learning baselines, in-context learning from trial-and-error experience followed by Experience Distillation matches their performance with at least \(9.6\times\) fewer environment samples.
articles.titleCn: 基于智能体经验的样本高效学习
articles.abstractCn: 现实世界智能体学习常常受到高成本环境交互的限制，例如运行耗时实验或获取人类反馈。情境学习为智能体从自身交互历史中学习提供了一种高度样本高效的途径，但当经验从情境中移除时，其收益便会消失。此外，情境蒸馏为将情境信息内化到模型权重中提供了一种机制。然而，在不牺牲环境样本效率的情况下将其应用于智能体的交互历史仍处于探索阶段。我们将此问题称为经验蒸馏，并开发了一种无需除收集到的经验外进一步与环境交互的实现方法。在749个精选的软件工程任务和六个文字冒险游戏上的实验表明，它在两个领域均保留了至少64.8%的情境学习的收益，而直接在收集到的经验上进行监督微调仅恢复了3.8%。与经典的强化学习基线相比，从试错经验中进行情境学习随后进行经验蒸馏，以至少9.6倍的更少环境样本量实现了与基线相当的性能。

articles.title: HiMe: Real-Time Self-Hosted Personal Agent Platform for Health Insights with Wearable Devices
articles.abstract: Traditional approaches to wearable health signal analysis, such as smartwatches, are constrained by rigid analytical frameworks and limited personalisation. The emergence of LLM agents creates a new opportunity for Personal Health Agentic Analysis, where health insights can be generated adaptively and in context. However, currently there is no open-source locally deployable platform capable of processing personal health data in real time while preserving privacy. We present HiMe, a locally deployable, privacy-first agent platform that is fully compatible with real-time health data ecosystems across a wide range of wearable devices. HiMe is guided by three design principles. The database is treated as a first-class component. Effectiveness and efficiency are jointly optimised to achieve a low-cost Pareto-optimal balance. Data are processed in real time while the user is modelled over the long term. Together, these principles make it practical for individuals to harness Personal Health Agents for continuous, personalised health monitoring for better wellbeing.
articles.titleCn: HiMe：基于可穿戴设备的实时自托管个人健康洞察平台
articles.abstractCn: 传统的可穿戴健康信号分析方法，如智能手表，受限于僵化的分析框架和有限的自定义能力。大型语言模型代理的出现为个人健康代理分析创造了新机遇，可以在适应性和情境中生成健康洞察。然而，目前尚无开源的本地部署平台能够实时处理个人健康数据并保护隐私。我们提出了HiMe，一个本地部署的、以隐私为先的代理平台，完全兼容各种可穿戴设备中的实时健康数据生态系统。HiMe遵循三个设计原则。数据库被视为一等组件。有效性和效率共同优化，以实现低成本帕累托最优平衡。数据实时处理，同时用户被长期建模。这些原则共同使个人能够利用个人健康代理进行持续、个性化的健康监测，以提升福祉。

articles.title: CultureTalk-ID: A Multi-Task Dialogue Benchmark for Cultural Commonsense in Indonesian Local Languages
articles.abstract: Culture is lived through conversation, yet existing Indonesian cultural commonsense benchmarks evaluate LLMs on short and isolated prompts, stripping away the dialogic context in which cultural nuances actually surface. We introduce CultureTalk-ID, the first dialogue-based benchmark for cultural commonsense in Indonesian and its local languages, comprising 4,496 culturally grounded dialogues across 11 languages and 13 culturally salient topics, curated through a multi-stage human pipeline with native speakers to ensure authenticity. CultureTalk-ID introduces three complementary tasks, namely dialogue-based multiple-choice cultural commonsense reasoning, culturally faithful machine translation, and language steering, which jointly probe whether LLMs can understand, transfer, and generate culturally grounded language.

articles.titleCn: 文化对话-ID：一种用于印尼地方语言文化常识的多任务对话基准
articles.abstractCn: 文化是通过对话来体验的，然而现有的印尼文化常识基准却在短小孤立的提示下评估LLM，剥离了文化细微之处实际浮现的对话情境。我们引入了CultureTalk-ID，这是首个基于对话的印尼及其地方语言文化常识基准，包含4,496个具有文化根基的对话，跨越11种语言和13个文化显著话题，通过多阶段由母语者参与的人工流程精心策划，以确保真实性。CultureTalk-ID引入了三项互补的任务，即基于对话的文化常识推理多选题、文化忠实机器翻译和语言引导，共同探究LLM是否能够理解、迁移和生成具有文化根基的语言。

articles.title: Where Animacy Lives in Large Language Models: Tracing the Circuits of the Animacy Concept
articles.abstract: Distinguishing animate from inanimate concepts in written language requires more than shallow text processing, as it involves recognizing complex selectional constraints and contextual cues, such as verb-argument interactions. Yet, current large language models (LLMs) appear to be capable of doing it. We investigate whether this animacy-sensitive behavior of LLMs can be traced to a localized set of causally relevant components and connections. To do so, we construct a controlled dataset of minimal pairs and perform circuit discovery on four open-weight models. Through in-depth experiments and ablations, we show that a causal mechanism responsible for handling animacy in these models does exist, thus discovering an animacy circuit. At the same time, this circuit appears to be less localized compared to other known ones and generalizes only partially across models and animacy tasks, confirming the distributed, context-dependent, and somewhat graded nature of the animacy concept.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中生命性的位置：追踪生命性概念回路
articles.abstractCn: 在书面语言中区分有生命和无生命概念需要超越浅层文本处理，因为它涉及识别复杂的选配限制和上下文线索，例如动词-论元交互。然而，当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）似乎能够完成这项任务。我们研究了LLMs的这种对生命敏感的行为是否可以追溯到一组局部相关的因果组件和连接。为此，我们构建了一个最小对控制数据集，并在四个开放权重模型上进行了电路发现。通过深入的实验和消融研究，我们表明在这些模型中确实存在一个处理生命概念的因果机制，从而发现了一个生命电路。与此同时，这个电路与其他已知电路相比似乎不那么局部化，并且仅部分地在模型和生命概念任务中泛化，证实了生命概念分布式、依赖上下文和一定程度上的等级性质。

articles.title: The Weight of Silence: A Causal Case for Weights Over the Scratchpad in Latent Chess Reasoning
articles.abstract: Latent, or silent, reasoning lets language models carry out intermediate computation in continuous vector space instead of words, and is widely assumed to function as an internal scratchpad the model consults during inference. Whether that assumption survives reinforcement learning has not been tested directly: existing causal analyses of latent reasoning are confined to math and logic tasks, comparing reliance on thoughts within one checkpoint, never before and after RL. We train a chess-playing model through a staged latent-reasoning curriculum followed by reinforcement learning, and find legality climbs monotonically to 61% (from a 48% pre-RL baseline) while checkmate confabulation is eliminated entirely. To locate this gain, we run a six-condition causal intervention suite on the same model before and after RL: substituting or noising the thought vectors leaves performance unchanged, ablating them costs only mild degradation, and only exact-zero vectors cause collapse. This robustness gap is itself the finding: under exact-zero corruption, legality collapses to 1% pre-RL versus 9% post-RL, a gap that survives correction across the full battery. A 10x-larger replication of the post-RL checkpoint's own battery confirms this: removing the thoughts, with or without restoring sequence length, also reaches significance; substitution and noise remain indistinguishable from baseline. RL appears to add robustness to disruption, not reliance on thought content. These results push back against the field's default assumption that latent thoughts function as an actively consulted inference-time scratchpad, and instead indicate latent reasoning's principal effect here is shaping the model's parameters during training. We also demonstrate a working RL gain in chess, where multiple groups report the same latent-reasoning-plus-RL recipe failing to improve accuracy over SFT.

articles.titleCn: 沉默的重量：潜在象棋推理中对工作区赋予权重的因果案例
articles.abstractCn: 潜在推理，或称沉默推理，使语言模型能够在连续向量空间中进行中间计算，而不是使用词语，并且普遍被认为是在推理过程中作为模型咨询的内部草稿纸。这一假设是否能在强化学习中得以验证尚未得到直接测试：现有的潜在推理因果分析仅限于数学和逻辑任务，比较的是单个检查点内的思维依赖，从未在强化学习之前和之后进行过比较。我们通过分阶段的潜在推理课程训练一个下棋模型，然后进行强化学习，发现合法性单调增加到61%（从强化学习前的48%基线），同时将将计谋完全消除。为了定位这一提升，我们在强化学习前后对同一模型运行了六种条件的因果干预套件：替换或添加噪声的思维向量不会改变性能，移除思维向量只会造成轻微退化，只有精确零向量才会导致崩溃。这种鲁棒性差距本身就是发现：在精确零向量干扰下，强化学习前的合法性降至1%，而强化学习后的合法性为9%，这一差距在完整电池测试中依然存在。一个10倍大的复制实验验证了强化学习后检查点的电池测试结果：移除思维向量，无论是否恢复序列长度，也达到了显著性；替换和噪声与基线无法区分。强化学习似乎增加了对干扰的鲁棒性，而不是对思维内容的依赖。这些结果挑战了该领域默认的假设，即潜在思维在推理时作为主动咨询的草稿纸，并表明潜在推理在此处的主要作用是在训练过程中塑造模型的参数。我们还展示了在象棋中工作的强化学习增益，多个团队报告了相同的潜在推理加强化学习配方未能提高SFT的准确率。

articles.title: From a Word-Level Dictionary to Sentence-Level Semantics: Multilingual Grievance Labelling with Contextual Models
articles.abstract: Grievance is one of the warning signs analysts look for when assessing threats of violence. It is increasingly measured at scale from online text, most often with word-level lexicons like the Grievance Dictionary that score by matching weighted terms. Such matching is a fast and transparent proxy, but it cannot resolve whether a term is asserted, quoted, negated, or condemned. These lexicons are also often evaluated on pools enriched with the very examples they retrieve, so a high score partly reflects agreement with the lexicon's own selection rule. Examining a five-language, 2{,}000-item evaluation pool, we find its halves separated almost perfectly by the lexicon itself: every item labeled ``random'' is in fact lexicon-negative, so the lexicon's apparent macro-AUROC of 0.686 collapses to a 0.500 floor fixed by construction. We keep the dictionary's 22-construct ontology but replace term matching with context-reading models, evaluated on a non-circular benchmark that separates unconditional-random, lexicon-positive, and lexicon-negative strata across five languages. Reading the full post rather than the target sentence alone helps most where the lexicon is silent, raising average precision on lexicon-negative text from 0.14 to 0.20, with the largest gains on quoted, implicit, and cross-sentence grievance. Together, these results show that grievance is measured more faithfully by reading the surrounding context, and more honestly when tested on text the lexicon did not select. We release our code and benchmark at https://github.com/behavioral-ds/multilingual_grievance.

articles.titleCn: 从词级词典到句级语义：多语言投诉标签与上下文模型
articles.abstractCn: 在评估暴力威胁时，分析师会关注不满情绪这一警示信号。如今，人们越来越多地从在线文本中大规模测量不满情绪，通常使用词级词汇表，如不满情绪词典，通过匹配加权词汇进行评分。这种匹配是一种快速且透明的代理方法，但它无法判断某个词汇是被断言、引用、否定还是谴责。这些词汇表也经常在包含其检索示例的丰富数据集上进行评估，因此高分部分反映了与词汇表自身选择规则的符合程度。通过检查一个包含5000个项目的五语言评估数据集，我们发现词汇表本身几乎完美地将数据集分成两半：所有被标记为“随机”的项目实际上都是词汇表负面的，因此词汇表看似的宏观AUROC值0.686降至由构造决定的0.500的底线。我们保留了词典的22个构念本体，但用上下文阅读模型替换了词汇匹配，并在一个非循环基准上进行评估，该基准将五种语言中的无条件随机、词汇表正面和词汇表负面层分开。阅读整篇帖子而不是仅目标句子有助于在词汇表沉默的情况下提高大多数项目的精度，将词汇表负面文本的平均精度从0.14提高到0.20，在引用、隐含和跨句不满情绪上取得了最大提升。综合这些结果表明，通过阅读周围上下文可以更准确地测量不满情绪，而在词汇表未选择文本上测试时则更诚实。我们在https://github.com/behavioral-ds/multilingual_grievance上发布了我们的代码和基准。

articles.title: Chemical Chain-of-Thought Functions as a Hallucination-Prone Molecular Scratchpad
articles.abstract: Chemical reasoning language models are expected to derive molecular answers through faithful chain-of-thought (CoT). However, across four reasoning model families and twelve chemistry tasks, hallucination is widespread and largely decoupled from answer correctness: correct answers often coexist with fabricated structural claims absent from the relevant molecules. Yet this does not make the reasoning trace computationally irrelevant. Attribution analyses suggest a shared scratchpad function expressed in model-specific forms: Chem-R and ether-0 rely on fragmented SMILES drafts, whereas ChemDFM-R emphasizes scaffold, positional, and naming cues. Notably, perturbing Chem-R's SMILES sketches degrades generation, showing that structural drafts can be causally load-bearing even when verbal structural claims are largely inert. Together, these results show that chemical CoT is neither a faithful explanation nor merely a post-hoc rationalization, but a hallucination-prone molecular scratchpad. This finding cautions against treating CoT as direct evidence of faithful reasoning and motivates process-level supervision beyond answer-only evaluation.

articles.titleCn: 化学思维链功能如同易产生幻觉的分子草稿纸
articles.abstractCn: 化学推理语言模型被期望通过可靠的思维链（CoT）推导出分子答案。然而，在四种推理模型家族和十二项化学任务中，幻觉现象普遍存在且与答案正确性基本无关：正确答案往往与相关分子中缺失的虚构结构主张共存。但这并未使推理轨迹在计算上变得无关紧要。归因分析表明，存在一种以模型特定形式表达的共同草稿板功能：Chem-R和ether-0依赖碎片化的SMILES草稿，而ChemDFM-R则强调骨架、位置和命名线索。值得注意的是，扰动Chem-R的SMILES草图会降低生成质量，表明即使语言结构主张基本无效，结构草稿仍可能具有因果承载能力。综合这些结果，化学CoT既不是可靠的解释，也不仅仅是事后合理化，而是一个易产生幻觉的分子草稿板。这一发现警示我们不应将CoT视为可靠推理的直接证据，并推动在仅评估答案之外进行过程层面的监督。

articles.title: Transformer-Assisted LLM-Based Source Code Summarisation: to Enable More Secure Software Development
articles.abstract: Neural Source Code Summarisation (NSCS) aims to generate natural language summaries of source code to improve developers' and maintainers' understanding of code. Source code summaries are vital during the maintenance phase of the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), as they improve maintainers' understanding of code and help reduce the number of bugs and vulnerabilities in a software system. However, summaries are often missing, incomplete, or outdated in many software systems. Solutions to this problem use small, task-specific Transformer models or code-aware Large Language Models (LLMs). Task-specific Transformer-generated summaries often score well across many natural language generation (NLG) metrics, but these metrics reward lexical overlap rather than summary quality. Conversely, the ability of LLMs to capture semantics and produce high-quality summaries presents an exciting solution to this problem. This is especially relevant given the increased availability of LLMs and improvements in workstation hardware in recent years, which mean that some LLMs can now be run on developers' workstations. However, because of their abstractive nature, LLM-generated code summaries often differ greatly from developer-written summaries in the words and phrases they use, resulting in low scores across NLG metrics. We show how combining these two methods, by using Transformer-generated summaries in prompt engineering, may enable LLMs to create better source code summaries and help software practitioners maintain secure systems. We prompt four LLMs using four different prompts, with a task-specific Transformer used to assist the LLMs within the prompts. We present "Transformer-Assisted LLM-Based Source Code Summarisation", a method through which we observe an improvement of 7.8% in BLEU-4 and 5%.
articles.comment: 10 pages
articles.titleCn: 基于Transformer辅助的大型语言模型源代码摘要：以实现更安全的软件开发
articles.abstractCn: 神经源代码摘要（NSCS）旨在生成源代码的自然语言摘要，以提高开发者和维护者对代码的理解。源代码摘要在整个安全软件开发生命周期（SSDLC）的维护阶段至关重要，因为它们有助于维护者理解代码，并有助于减少软件系统中错误和漏洞的数量。然而，在许多软件系统中，摘要往往缺失、不完整或过时。解决此问题的方案使用小型、特定任务的Transformer模型或代码感知的大型语言模型（LLMs）。特定任务的Transformer生成的摘要在许多自然语言生成（NLG）指标上得分良好，但这些指标奖励词汇重叠而非摘要质量。相反，LLMs捕捉语义和生成高质量摘要的能力为解决这个问题提供了令人兴奋的方案。鉴于近年来LLMs的可用性增加和工作站硬件的改进，这使得某些LLMs现在可以在开发者的工作站上运行，这一点尤其相关。然而，由于它们的抽象特性，LLM生成的代码摘要在使用的词语和短语上与开发者编写的摘要差异很大，导致在NLG指标上得分较低。我们展示了通过在提示工程中使用Transformer生成的摘要来结合这两种方法，可以使LLMs创建更好的源代码摘要，并帮助软件从业者维护安全系统。我们使用四种不同的提示提示了四种LLMs，并使用一个特定任务的Transformer在提示中协助LLMs。我们提出了“Transformer辅助的基于LLM源代码摘要”方法，通过该方法我们观察到BLEU-4和5%的改进达到了7.8%。

articles.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
articles.abstract: We introduce Tencent WorkBuddy Bench, a multi-domain evaluation suite for coding agents; this report documents its construction methodology, scoring protocol, and a cross-model leaderboard. At its core is a unified evaluation framework for constructing and running distribution-informed coding-agent tasks across four work domains - Code, Web, Office, and Security. Rather than adapting public issue text, every task is reverse-engineered from a real commit, pull request, or business scenario and rewritten as a short, colloquial, role-played request, so that a task's prompt is not recoverable by web-searching the underlying issue, pull request, or commit thread. Because the dataset is released openly - task directories, environment images, evaluation harness, tests, and reference solutions - contamination resistance rests on this construction together with dataset versioning rather than on secrecy. The four subsets - repository-level engineering, front-end development, office and business workflows, and red-/blue-team security - probe complementary facets of real work, each with its own verification style. All are packaged in a uniform task-directory format and run, under a uniform and reproducible protocol, on two agent harnesses (CodeBuddy Code and Claude Code); the full open release makes the benchmark reproducible end to end and directly auditable, since any third party can re-run each task and inspect its content. Because each subset uses a different scoring instrument, scores are not comparable across subsets and the suite reports no suite-wide average. We report a cross-model leaderboard across several model families.
articles.comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. Project page: https://workbuddybench.com/ ; code: https://github.com/Tencent/workbuddy-bench ; dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tencent/workbuddy-bench
articles.titleCn: 腾讯WorkBuddy基准：一个具有抗污染任务构建的多领域编码代理基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了腾讯WorkBuddy Bench，这是一个用于编码代理的多领域评估套件；本报告记录了其构建方法、评分协议以及跨模型的排行榜。其核心是一个统一的评估框架，用于构建和运行分布感知的编码代理任务，涵盖四个工作领域——代码、网页、办公和安全。与调整公开问题文本不同，每个任务都是从真实的提交、拉取请求或业务场景中逆向工程，并改写为简短、口语化、角色扮演的请求，以确保任务的提示无法通过搜索底层问题、拉取请求或提交线程来恢复。由于数据集公开发布——任务目录、环境镜像、评估框架、测试和参考解决方案——抗污染性依赖于这种构建方式以及数据集版本控制，而非保密性。四个子集——仓库级工程、前端开发、办公和业务流程、红队/蓝队安全——探测了实际工作的互补方面，每个子集都有其独特的验证方式。所有内容都打包在统一的任务目录格式中，并在统一的可重复协议下，通过两个代理框架（CodeBuddy Code和Claude Code）运行；完整的公开发布使基准可端到端重复，并可直接审计，因为任何第三方都可以重新运行每个任务并检查其内容。由于每个子集使用不同的评分工具，因此子集之间的分数不可比，该套件也不报告套件范围的平均值。我们报告了跨多个模型系列的跨模型排行榜。

articles.title: LegalCiteTrust: Benchmarking Citation Trustworthiness in Chinese Long-Form Legal Research Reports
articles.abstract: Long-form legal research reports increasingly rely on LLMs and agentic research systems, but their reliability depends not only on answering the task, but also on whether cited legal authorities are trustworthy. A citation can be risky even when it points to a real source: the report may omit limiting conditions, misdescribe the authority, or use it to support a stronger claim than the source allows. We introduce LegalCiteTrust, a benchmark for evaluating citation trustworthiness in Chinese long-form legal research reports. It contains 72 densely annotated report-level tasks and evaluates reports along three dimensions: Coverage, Support, and Citation Trustworthiness. Citation Trustworthiness is operationalized through citation-level Existence, Fidelity, and Applicability (E/F/A). Experiments on general-purpose LLMs, deep-research systems, and legal-specific systems show that task completion, evidence richness, citation density, and citation reliability expose different system behaviors. Retrieval tools can improve evidence support without reliably improving the Trust score, while E/F/A-based revision improves Trust and Final score more clearly than existence-only filtering. These results suggest that trustworthy legal research generation requires citation-aware evidence governance after retrieval: systems must not only retrieve legal authorities, but also select, describe, and apply them reliably.

articles.titleCn: LegalCiteTrust：中文长篇法律研究报告引文可信度基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 长篇法律研究报告越来越多地依赖大型语言模型和代理式研究系统，但其可靠性不仅取决于能否完成任务，还取决于所引用的法律依据是否可信。即使引用指向真实来源，引用也可能存在风险：报告可能遗漏限制条件、错误描述依据，或使用其支持超出来源允许范围的更强主张。我们介绍了LegalCiteTrust，这是一个用于评估中文长篇法律研究报告引用可信度的基准。它包含72个密集标注的报告级任务，并沿三个维度评估报告：覆盖范围、支持力度和引用可信度。引用可信度通过引用级的存在性、忠实性和适用性（E/F/A）来具体化。在通用型大型语言模型、深度研究系统和法律专用系统上的实验表明，任务完成度、证据丰富度、引用密度和引用可靠性揭示了不同的系统行为。检索工具可以在不显著提升可信度得分的情况下增强证据支持，而基于E/F/A的修订比仅存在性过滤更能更清晰地提升可信度和最终得分。这些结果表明，可信的法律研究生成需要在检索后进行引用感知的证据治理：系统不仅要检索法律依据，还必须可靠地选择、描述和应用它们。

articles.title: Position Bias is Hidden Behind Ceiling Effects: A Permutation Diagnostic for LLM Benchmarks
articles.abstract: Position bias in multiple-choice LLM evaluation is widely cited as a confound in capability comparisons, but published measurements rely on single answer-order shuffles whose results confound the bias signal with content-level noise and sampling stochasticity. I introduce inspect_permute, an open-source extension to the inspect_ai evaluation framework that runs exhaustive answer-order permutations per question and reports the chi-squared / Cramer V signature of position bias with bootstrap confidence intervals. I apply the tool across four vendors (gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash, grok-3) on five MMLU subjects, 24,000 API calls under temperature-0 generation, with falsifier predictions pre-registered via a public SHA-256 hash before half the data was observed. Position bias turns out to be statistically detectable only within a roughly 60-95% base-accuracy Goldilocks zone. Below it, processing-load dominance swamps subject-specific signal; above it, ceiling effects compress the variance below the chi-squared test resolution. Detectable cells separate into two mechanism types: monotone A-to-D decrease (processing_load, in low-tier models) and non-monotone D-drop (content_ambiguity, in a narrow capability band). Standard MMLU places every frontier-tier model above the detection band, so absence of signal there should be read as not measurable, not unbiased. Together with the ceiling-effect characterisation in arXiv:2606.26185, this work brackets the detectable region of position-bias measurement and makes the field central question askable in a verifiable form. Package, data, preregistration under MIT.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 2 appendices. Code, data, and preregistration verification at https://github.com/TambaClan/inspect_permute. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.26185
articles.titleCn: 天花板效应之下隐藏着位置偏差：用于大型语言模型基准测试的置换诊断
articles.abstractCn: 在多项选择题的大型语言模型评估中，位置偏差被广泛引用为能力比较中的混杂因素，但已发表的测量方法依赖于单一答案顺序的随机化，其结果将偏差信号与内容层面的噪声和采样随机性混杂在一起。我引入了inspect_permute，这是一个开源的inspect_ai评估框架扩展，它针对每个问题运行详尽的答案顺序排列，并报告位置偏差的卡方/Cramer V特征及其引导置信区间。我应用该工具在四个供应商（gpt-4o-mini、claude-haiku-4-5、gemini-2.5-flash、grok-3）上对五个MMLU主题进行评估，共24,000次API调用，在温度-0生成条件下，通过公开的SHA-256哈希值预先注册了伪造预测，在观察到一半数据之前。结果表明，位置偏差仅在约60-95%的基础准确率黄金区间内具有统计可检测性。低于该区间，处理负载优势会淹没特定主题的信号；高于该区间，天花板效应会压缩方差至卡方检验分辨率以下。可检测的单元分为两种机制类型：单调A到D递减（处理负载，在低级别模型中）和非单调D下降（内容模糊性，在一个狭窄的能力范围内）。标准MMLU将所有前沿级模型置于检测带之上，因此在该处缺乏信号应被解读为不可测量而非偏差。结合arXiv:2606.26185中的天花板效应特征，这项工作界定了位置偏差测量的可检测区域，并使该领域核心问题以可验证的形式变得可问。代码、数据和预先注册在MIT许可证下提供。

articles.title: CSPF: A Constrained Shared-Private Fusion Method for Non-Verifiable Preference Evaluation
articles.abstract: At present, reliable evaluation of non-verifiable tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often fail to adequately capture the diverse evaluative criteria underlying human preferences in such tasks. To this end, we propose Constrained Shared-Private Fusion (CSPF), a fusion method that treats heterogeneous frozen reward models as complementary evaluators and learns to integrate their hidden-state representations under pairwise human-preference supervision. CSPF decomposes each expert signal into shared and expert-private representations, encouraging cross-expert alignment while preserving complementary viewpoints. Across experiments on LM-Arena target-domain adaptation and PPE out-of-distribution preference evaluation, CSPF achieves the best performance on the primary metrics among the evaluated single-expert reward-model, scalar-score multi-expert, and rubric-judge baselines. Overall, CSPF suggests that fusing hidden-state representations provides a more expressive basis for preference assessment, offering a practical route toward integrated evaluative signals for non-verifiable preference tasks.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
articles.titleCn: CSPF：一种用于不可验证偏好评估的约束共享-私有融合方法
articles.abstractCn: 目前，对不可验证任务进行可靠评估仍然具有挑战性。现有方法往往无法充分捕捉此类任务中人类偏好背后多样化的评估标准。为此，我们提出了约束共享-私有融合（CSPF）方法，这是一种将异构冻结奖励模型视为互补评估者的融合方法，并在成对人类偏好监督下学习整合其隐藏状态表示。CSPF将每个专家信号分解为共享和专家私有表示，在鼓励跨专家对齐的同时保留互补视角。在LM-Arena目标域适应和PPE分布外偏好评估的实验中，CSPF在评估的单专家奖励模型、标量分数多专家和评分裁判基线中，在主要指标上实现了最佳性能。总体而言，CSPF表明融合隐藏状态表示为偏好评估提供了更具表达力的基础，为不可验证偏好任务的综合评估信号提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: REFACT: Adaptive Fact Restatement for Compact and Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly leverage long-form reasoning to solve complex tasks, yet their reasoning processes can deviate from the provided context when evidence is incomplete, noisy, or conflicts with parametric knowledge. Existing grounding approaches either append citations after generation or encourage LLMs to retrieve evidence during reasoning, but they often fail to ensure that cited information is sufficient to support intermediate inferences and final answers. To address this limitation, we propose REFACT, an adaptive fact-restatement citation framework that enables LLMs to determine when contextual grounding is needed and selectively restate source facts at appropriate levels of detail for reliable reasoning. To facilitate adaptive citation during reasoning, REFACT first leverages a teacher LLM to construct high-quality citation-aware reasoning trajectories under diverse context conditions with varying evidence lengths, and then optimizes the student LLM through a two-stage SFT-to-RL framework. Experiments on LongBench, LV-Eval, and ConFiQA demonstrate that REFACT improves long-context question answering and counterfactual faithfulness while substantially reducing the number of reasoning tokens. Further analysis reveals that REFACT achieves higher evidence density by preserving more answer-relevant facts with fewer restatements, producing reasoning traces that are more concise yet better grounded. All code and data will be released via https://github.com/NEUIR/REFACT.
articles.titleCn: REFACT：自适应事实重述，用于紧凑且忠实于思想的推理链
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地利用长形式推理来解决复杂任务，但在证据不完整、嘈杂或与参数化知识冲突时，它们的推理过程可能会偏离所提供的上下文。现有的接地方法要么在生成后附加引用，要么鼓励LLMs在推理过程中检索证据，但它们往往无法确保所引用的信息足以支持中间推理和最终答案。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了REFACT，一个自适应事实重述引用框架，它使LLMs能够确定何时需要上下文接地，并在适当的详细程度级别上选择性地重述来源事实，以进行可靠的推理。为了在推理过程中促进自适应引用，REFACT首先利用教师LLM在多样化的上下文条件下，针对不同长度的证据构建高质量的引用感知推理轨迹，然后通过一个两阶段的SFT到RL框架优化学生LLM。在LongBench、LV-Eval和ConFiQA上的实验表明，REFACT提高了长上下文问答和反事实忠实度，同时大幅减少了推理token的数量。进一步分析揭示，REFACT通过保留更多与答案相关的、更少重述的事实，实现了更高的证据密度，产生了更简洁但更可靠的推理轨迹。所有代码和数据将通过https://github.com/NEUIR/REFACT发布。

articles.title: Beyond Heavy Log Curation: Perplexity-Based APT Detection via Unsupervised, Context-Augmented Language Models

authors.name: Toshiaki Koike-Akino
authors.affiliation: Context-Augmented Perplexity-based Threat Activity log detectIoN

articles.abstract: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) remain difficult to detect because only a small fraction of events in large-scale logs are attack-related, and investigation is expensive and hard to scale. Prior machine-learning approaches can reduce analyst workload, but they often rely on heavily curated training data and sophisticated preprocessing pipelines. Building and maintaining such pipelines require substantial domain expertise and engineering cost. Motivated by insights from a study of a strong APT detection baseline, we propose CAPTAIN (Context-Augmented Perplexity-based Threat Activity log detectIoN), a perplexity-based detector that leverages general, pre-trained language models with minimal, domain-agnostic preprocessing, enabling robust scoring of long, minimally processed log entries. CAPTAIN encodes recent history with an encoder model and a Q-Former-style bridge, then injects the compact context tokens into the decoder input so that perplexity reflects temporal context. To improve stability, CAPTAIN additionally applies smoothing filters to the perplexity time series. Across APT-oriented benchmarks, CAPTAIN competes with strong existing baselines and remains robust under substantially less curated inputs, that reduces the development and operational cost of advanced log preprocessing.

articles.titleCn: 超越重型日志管理：基于困惑度的APT检测，通过无监督、上下文增强语言模型实现
articles.abstractCn: 高级持续性威胁（APTs）之所以难以检测，是因为在大规模日志中只有一小部分事件与攻击相关，而调查工作既昂贵又难以扩展。先前的机器学习方法可以减轻分析人员的工作量，但它们通常依赖于高度精选的训练数据和复杂的预处理流程。构建和维护此类流程需要大量的领域专业知识和工程成本。受一项关于强大APT检测基线的研究的启发，我们提出了CAPTAIN（基于上下文的困惑度增强威胁活动日志检测），这是一种基于困惑度的检测器，它利用通用预训练语言模型，并采用最少量的领域无关预处理，从而能够对长且最少处理过的日志条目进行稳健评分。CAPTAIN使用编码器模型和Q-Former风格的桥接编码近期历史，然后将紧凑的上下文标记注入解码器输入，使困惑度反映时间上下文。为了提高稳定性，CAPTAIN还对接惑度时间序列应用平滑滤波器。在面向APT的基准测试中，CAPTAIN与强大的现有基线竞争，并在显著较少的精选输入下保持稳健，从而降低了高级日志预处理的开发和运营成本。

articles.title: The Geometry of Personality: Activation Steering with Jungian Cognitive Functions
articles.abstract: Activation steering enables control and interpretation of LLMs, yet existing work primarily models personality through static trait frameworks such as the Big Five. We investigate whether personality can instead be represented and controlled as a set of cognitive processes using the eight Jungian Cognitive Functions. To this end, we introduce a framework comprising a Jungian evaluation protocol and a dataset of over 2,100 role-playing character narrations. Activation steering vector extraction and evaluation experiments on Llama-3.1-8B demonstrate effective monotonic control over all eight cognitive functions through activation steering. Beyond controllability, our analysis reveals that: 1. personality information is concentrated in middle transformer layers; 2. steering vectors exhibit structured geometric relationships consistent with distinctions between rational and irrational functions; 3. effective multi-dimensional steering directions cannot be recovered as linear combinations of single-function directions. These findings provide new insights into the representation of personality in LLM activation space and establish a framework for studying interpretable, effective, and multi-dimensional personality control.

articles.titleCn: 人格的几何学：荣格认知功能的激活引导
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导能够控制和解释大型语言模型，但现有工作主要通过大五人格等静态特质框架来建模人格。我们研究人格是否可以改用八种荣格认知功能来表示和控制。为此，我们引入了一个包含荣格评估协议和超过2,100个角色扮演角色叙述数据集的框架。在Llama-3.1-8B上的激活引导向量提取和评估实验表明，通过激活引导对所有八种认知功能实现了有效的单调控制。除了可控性之外，我们的分析还揭示了：1. 人格信息集中在中间的Transformer层；2. 引导向量表现出与理性功能和非理性功能区别一致的有序几何关系；3. 有效的多维引导方向不能作为单一功能方向的线性组合来恢复。这些发现为理解LLM激活空间中的人格表示提供了新见解，并建立了一个研究可解释、有效和多维度人格控制的框架。
